title: Knockout Garlicky Irish Lamb Toast
description: A rich and savory Irish dish featuring lamb, garlic, and toasted bread, all cooked to perfection in a tajine clay vessel. This halal-friendly recipe is perfect for satisfying midnight cravings.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the lamb until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over low heat.
Add the shredded cheese to the saucepan and stir until melted and smooth.
Arrange the bread slices in the bottom of the tajine clay vessel.
Spoon the lamb and garlic mixture over the bread.
Pour the melted cheese sauce over the top of the lamb.
Cover the vessel with a lid and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the lid and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
